integrity: The bundled standard-library code reconstructs the full integral chain calculation and all 240 symmetry-character checks. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: An exact theorem for the 5-by-5 deleted-diagonal matching complex only. The degree-two rank was known from Shareshian–Wachs Table 8.1; newly classified are complete degree-three integral homology and degree-two/degree-three symmetry actions. No homotopy classification or results for other board sizes are claimed. Unindexed equivalent coverage remains possible.
title: The full symmetric-group and transpose homology of the five-by-five diagonal-deleted chessboard
